title: Chapter 11 — The Italy Man
description: Oga Felix offers a million naira for five girls. This is the line. Which side of it are you on?

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Oga Felix wears a Juventus jersey and a Rolex that ticks too loudly. He talks softly, like a man who has never needed to talk loudly.

beats.speaker: felix
beats.text: Madam. I place girls in Italy. Hotel jobs, salon jobs, nanny jobs. Very good money. They send dollars home. Everybody is happy.

beats.speaker: felix
beats.text: Five of your girls. ₦200,000 each. A million naira. (He looks at the bar.) That one. The new one who smiles. Blessing. Italy will love her.

variants.text: A million naira. (He looks at the stairs.) Young ones. The new ones. Italy loves them young.

beats.speaker: kemi
beats.text: (From the stairs, very quietly.) Mama. My cousin went with an "Italy man". She called once. From a number in Libya. Then never again.

beats.speaker: felix
beats.text: He puts a bag on the table. It is heavy.

options.text: Smile. "Let me think. Come back on Friday." Then call NAPTIP.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The NAPTIP office is a bungalow behind the motor park with a cracked sign and an officer who looks like she has not slept since 2015. Officer Grace Okon.

beats.speaker: officerGrace
beats.text: Madam. You run a... hotel. (She doesn't say the other word. She doesn't need to.) And you want to help me catch a trafficker.

beats.speaker: officerGrace
beats.text: I need him on tape. Saying what he does. Saying where they go. He must trust you. Can you lie to a man like that?

variants.text: (She listens to the recording twice. Her hand is shaking a little.) "Tripoli, then Sicily." He said it. In his own voice. (She looks at you.) Madam, whatever you are, today you are a witness.
(She swears very quietly.) He knows. Then he will come for you before he goes. Lock your gate, Madam.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Blessing finds you in the store room, counting Felix's money with your back to the door.

variants.text: Kemi finds you in the store room, counting Felix's money with your back to the door.

beats.speaker: blessing
beats.text: Mama. Please. (She is not crying. That is worse.) I don't want Italy. I want my salon. I will work. I will pay you. Please don't sell me.

variants.text: (Kemi.) Mama. You knew my cousin. You came to her mother's house when she didn't call. (Very quietly.) Don't do this.

beats.speaker: player
beats.text: The money is very heavy in your hands.

options.text: Give the bag back to Felix tonight. Whatever it costs.
"It is a good job. You will thank me."

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Late. The girls sit on the bar with their shoes off. Somebody has made Indomie for everybody. Precious is doing impressions of Bassey, badly and perfectly.

beats.speaker: kemi
beats.text: Mama. Why do you do this? Not the money. I mean, why this?

beats.speaker: kemi
beats.text: They all go quiet. They have never asked.

options.text: Tell them about Warri, and the wrong address, and the first night.

beats.speaker: kemi
beats.text: (After a long time.) So you were Blessing. (Nobody says anything. Precious offers you her egg.)

beats.title: The Italy Man
beats.summary: You were offered the price of a life, five times over. What you did with it is already in the street's mouth.
